test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the most suitable title for the passage.

options.text: Pangs of the Migrant Kyrgyz Women

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage highlights **the challenges faced by Kyrgyz women who migrate to Russia for work, indicating significant difficulties or struggles, hence "pangs" best captures this.**
 
• Option 1 (Power of Education in Kyrgyzstan) is incorrect as the passage does not discuss education extensively.
 
• Option 2 (Independence of the Kyrgyz Women) is incorrect because, while women are working and contributing, the passage emphasizes their struggles rather than independence.
 
• Option 3 (Gift of Russian Service) does not accurately capture the issues faced by the migrant women as it paints an overly positive picture.
 
• **Option 4 (Pangs of the Migrant Kyrgyz Women) best fits the context of the passage, focusing on the hardships experienced by these migrant women.**

Therefore, the correct option is **Option 4.**
